def factor_intraday_momentum_volume_amplifier(df):
    """Intraday momentum amplified by volume change. Large intraday directional moves on expanding volume are more reliable."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    _, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    smooth_ret = intraday_ret.rolling(5, min_periods=5).mean()
    base_signal = np.sign(smooth_ret) * np.abs(smooth_ret) ** 2
    vol_chg = df_copy["volume"].pct_change()
    amplification = np.clip(1.0 + vol_chg, 0.5, 2.0)
    factor = base_signal * amplification
    df_copy["factor_intraday_momentum_volume_amplifier"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_intraday_momentum_volume_amplifier"]
